audit_items.classification_reason: Component mismatch: Prysm is an Ethereum Consensus Layer (CL) client. Block number sequential validation (parent.number + 1) is an Execution Layer (EL) responsibility performed by EL clients (Geth, Nethermind, etc.) during block header validation. The CL client receives execution payloads via Engine API but does not validate EL block header fields.

Component mismatch: Prysm is an Ethereum Consensus Layer (CL) client. Parent hash cryptographic verification (parent_hash == keccak256(rlp.encode(parent_header))) is an Execution Layer (EL) responsibility. The EL client validates block header integrity; the CL client trusts the EL's validation via the Engine API.

Component mismatch: Prysm is an Ethereum Consensus Layer (CL) client. Excess blob gas calculation validation is an Execution Layer (EL) responsibility. The EL client calculates and validates excess_blob_gas from parent state; the CL client receives this value in the execution payload but does not recompute or validate the EL-specific calculation.

Component mismatch: Prysm is an Ethereum Consensus Layer (CL) client. Gas accounting validation (gas_used <= gas_limit) in block headers is an Execution Layer (EL) responsibility performed during EL block validation. The CL client does not validate EL gas accounting constraints.

Component mismatch: Prysm is an Ethereum Consensus Layer (CL) client. System transaction origin validation (SYSTEM_ADDRESS = 0xff...fe) is an Execution Layer (EL) concept. The EL client processes system transactions and enforces address-based access controls in the EVM. The CL does not have visibility into EL transaction-level execution details.

Component mismatch: Prysm is an Ethereum Consensus Layer (CL) client. Base fee calculation (calculate_base_fee_per_gas) enforcing minimum increase when gas exceeds target is an Execution Layer (EL) responsibility. The EL client implements EIP-1559 base fee calculation; the CL client receives the calculated base_fee_per_gas in execution payloads.

Component mismatch: Prysm is an Ethereum Consensus Layer (CL) client. Transaction validation ordering (transaction_validation_dispatch) is an Execution Layer (EL) responsibility. The EL client validates transaction type, fees, gas limits, and authorization; the CL client does not perform transaction-level validation.

Component mismatch: Prysm is an Ethereum Consensus Layer (CL) client. Extra data length validation (32 bytes) in block headers is an Execution Layer (EL) responsibility enforced during EL block header validation (validate_header). The CL client does not validate EL block header field constraints.

Component mismatch: Prysm is an Ethereum Consensus Layer (CL) client. Gas limit change bounds validation (parent_gas_limit // 1024) is an Execution Layer (EL) responsibility enforced during EL block validation (check_gas_limit). The CL client does not validate EL gas limit adjustments.

Component mismatch: Prysm is an Ethereum Consensus Layer (CL) client. Gas limit minimum validation (>= 5000 GAS_LIMIT_MINIMUM) is an Execution Layer (EL) responsibility enforced during EL block validation (check_gas_limit). The CL client does not validate EL gas limit constraints.
